# Cncf Monokle Reviewer

Review Monokle using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. Monokle helps you achieve high-quality Kubernetes deployments throughout the entire application lifecycle — from code to cluster.  It enables your team to define Kubernetes configuration policies to ensure consistent, secure, and compliant application deployments every time. In addition to policy enforcement,  Monokle’s ecosystem of tools make your team’s daily YAML configuration workflows easier. Monokle is created and maintained by Kubeshop.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
